Overview panel with Nivo radar chart showing factor exposure profile, expanded summary table, and conviction/consensus indicators
Regression summary table displaying R², alpha, conviction, and consensus factors with model toggle and window filtering
Tab component with bar chart showing factor tilts across portfolios (snapshot mode) and embedded ModelTiltTimeSeriesView (time series mode)

page_structure.tab: Bar chart showing factor tilts across all model portfolios with snapshot mode (clustered bar chart) and time series mode (embedded ModelTiltTimeSeriesView). Includes lookback window selector in snapshot mode. Tier 3 loading triggered when switching to time series view.

Line chart showing rolling cumulative returns of market factor spreads with factor selection checkboxes, rolling window selector (1M/3M/6M/1Y), and display window selector (1M/3M/6M/1Y/2Y). Tier 2 data loading triggered when tab is clicked.
page_structure.overview_panel: Nivo radar chart visualization of factor tilts with portfolio and lookback dropdowns. Right panel shows expanded summary: regression table (R², alpha, conviction, consensus) and factor exposures grid with gradient bars. Portfolio/lookback selectors in header. Methodology note for AGG portfolio AUM-weighted calculations.

data_flow.flow: Page mount triggers Promise.all([getFactorTiltsSnapshot(), getAUMMetrics()]) → data transformed via transformSnapshotToDataset() → AUM weights used to compute AGG metrics via computeAggregateMetrics() → merged back into dataset → setData() → Overview panel and bars chart rendered

User clicks Factor Spreads tab → handleTabChangeWithLazyLoad('timeseries') → loadTier2() triggered → getFactorTiltsSpreads() fetched → mergeSpreadsIntoDataset() transforms to factorTimeSeries → setTier2Loaded(true) → FactorTiltTimeSeriesTab renders with data

User clicks "Time Series" button in Bars tab → handleViewModeChange('timeseries') → onLoadTier3() called → getFactorTiltsTimeSeries() fetched → mergeTimeSeriesIntoDataset() loads modelTiltTimeSeries → setTier3Loaded(true) → ModelTiltTimeSeriesView renders with data

Array of 6 factors in canonical order: Equity vs FI, Growth vs Value, US vs Foreign, Large vs Small, Agg vs Short, HY vs Agg (matched to Yang's PKL exactly)
Detailed metadata for each factor with descriptions and long/short sides
High-contrast colors for factor lines in spreads chart: red, purple, blue, yellow, orange, green

performance_notes.note: Tier 1 (~46 KB) loads on mount and powers Overview + Bars views. Tier 2 (~196 KB) loads lazily on Factor Spreads tab click. Tier 3 (~2.1 MB) loads on Time Series toggle. Default page load reduced from 2.3 MB to 46 KB (99% reduction).
Tier 2 and Tier 3 data cached in state after first load (tier2Loaded, tier3Loaded flags prevent re-fetching)

FactorTiltOverviewPanel adjusts radar chart margins, label offsets, and font size based on viewport width for Surface Laptop (~1280px), Medium screens (~1536px), Large screens (~1920px), and Very Large screens (1920+px)
Chart data, Y-axis domain, and legend/line configurations memoized to prevent unnecessary re-renders during tab switches and selection changes

issues.issue: Factor keys changed from 'Short vs Agg' to 'Agg vs Short' and from 'HY vs IG' to 'HY vs Agg' to match Yang's PKL exactly. Comments note this change was made.

data_sources.source: Provides getFactorTiltsSnapshot(), getFactorTiltsSpreads(), getFactorTiltsTimeSeries() via portal-proxy. Data represents regression-based factor analysis for 5 model portfolios + aggregate with multiple lookback windows.

visual_design.color_scheme: AGG: #5e72e4 (purple/indigo) UST: #f97316 (orange) ST: #f59e0b (amber/yellow) INT: #10b981 (green) LTC: #3b82f6 (blue) LTA: #ef4444 (red) Primary accent: hsl(var(--primary-sky)) = sky-400 (Opal marker color) Success: emerald-400 (positive tilts/values) Danger: red-400 (negative tilts/values)
visual_design.layout_patterns: Overview Panel: 2-column grid (1 col on mobile) with radar chart (left) and expanded summary (right) Radar Chart: Factor labels positioned outside with responsive offsets based on viewport Factor Exposures Table: Dual-column grid with fixed width factor names/abbreviations/values on left, gradient bars on right Tab Content: Full-width responsive containers with h-[400px] or h-[350px] charts Controls: Compact dropdowns and button groups in panel headers with flex layout
